spans.s:
लोच् {vI.v} {c1c} A. (लोचते) To see,
view, perceive, observe. {vII.v} {c10c} U.
or Caus. (लोचयति-ते) To cause to
see. {vIII.v} {c10c} U. (लोचयति-ते)
1
To speak.
--2 To shine.

लोचकः [लोच्-ण्वुल्]
1 A stupid
person.
--2 The pupil of the eye.
--3
Lamp-black, collyrium.
--4 A kind
of ear-ring.
--5 A dark or blue
garment.
--6 A bow-string.
--7 A
particular ornament worn by women on
the forehead.
--8 A lump of flesh.
--9 The slough of a snake.
--10 A
wrinkled skin.
--11 The wrinkled
brow.
--12 A plantain tree.

लोचन a. (नी f.)
1 Illuminating,
brightening.
--2 Visible.
--नं [
लोच्यतेऽनेन लोच्-करणे ल्युट्]
1 Seeing,
sight, viewing.
--2 The eye;
शेषान्मासान् गमय चतुरो लोचने मीलयित्वा

.
--Comp.
--गोचरः, --पथः,
--मार्गः the range of sight, sphere of
vision.
--हिता blue vitriol.
